tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: List unstaged changes (including untracked files) as numbered lines with pagination.

tools.name: diff
tools.description: View complete numbered diff for a single file (no truncation).

tools.name: apply_changes
tools.description: Apply selected change numbers to the git index (supports partial staging).

tools.name: auto_commit
tools.description: Autopilot mode to group changes into focused commits.

trust.notes: Added for demo/testing as a vetted entry. Requires git installed and a git repo workspace for meaningful results.
trust.securityNotes: Can stage changes and create commits. Use in trusted repos only; consider restricting or reviewing auto_commit usage.
